question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Show a breakdown: total customers, customers who rented any film with top 5 actors, and the percentage
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) AS total_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS customers_with_top5_films,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer), 2) AS percentage
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
WHERE fa.actor_id IN (107, 102, 198, 181, 23)
